music.name: R&B & Ready
music.why: Guided R&B singles mixer format designed for actual conversation, not a typical club night
music.summary: R&B & Ready returns to Château Walnut Creek for a guided R&B singles mixer, Tuesday August 11 - timeless R&B, handcrafted cocktails, and guided connection experiences for singles.

music.name: Motown on Mondays
music.why: A 15+ year weekly institution for free early-night Motown dancing, no ticket needed
music.summary: DJ Gordo Cabeza and weekly guest DJs spin Motown originals and remixes at Madrone Art Bar's long-running Monday night dance party, free before 8pm.

music.name: BABYMOROCCO
music.why: Popscene's midweek electronic bill in an intimate 155-cap room
music.summary: Popscene and Rickshaw Stop co-present BABYMOROCCO, an electronic music show with support from Harmony Tividad, at the all-ages Fell Street venue.

music.name: Run It Back Presents: Casmalia
music.why: Free RSVP before 11pm gets an EDC/Coachella-tour LA headliner into F8's back room on a Wednesday
music.summary: Run It Back brings LA producer Casmalia (Insomniac Records, mau5trap, Night Bass) to headline F8's back room, backed by a full local support lineup and free RSVP before 11pm.

music.name: Salty Residency: Seth Finkin
music.why: SF beach-party and pop-up renegade DJ Seth Finkin headlines a residency night with free happy-hour plaza set before the paid club room
music.summary: Salty Sundays Productions residency night at Napa Music Hall: San Francisco DJ Seth Finkin (disco, house, world percussion) with residents Mark G and Tamer. Outdoor plaza happy hour 6-9PM is free; club room 9PM-late is $25.

music.name: HYPENYTE
music.why: Always-free birthday-vibe night at an intimate bar, not a cover-charge club crawl
music.summary: HYPENYTE hits Monty Bar Thursday August 13, 9pm-2am, with hosts Gina Kuhn and _babyuniq_ - a free celebratory night out.

music.name: Organic: Tribute to DJ Dan
music.why: A legacy house/funk lineup honoring a Bay Area DJ icon at an intimate hotel-pool venue
music.summary: Organic hosts a tribute to the late DJ Dan with a stacked house/funky-house lineup (DJ Sneak, DJ Heather, DJ Colette, Jeno, DJ Spun, Donald Glaude) at the Phoenix Hotel.

music.name: Mostly Cloudy x Keep Hush: BADSISTA, BAE BAE + more
music.why: A 7-hour, Brazil-to-Bay-Area baile funk/techno/latin-club marathon streamed live by Keep Hush
music.summary: Mostly Cloudy teams with the Keep Hush platform for seven hours of baile funk, techno and latin club from DJs across Brazil, LA and the Bay Area at The Great Northern.

music.name: STRAPT: IYKUK, Discnogirl, DJ CARO
music.why: Houston club star IYKUK's Bay Area debut, hosted by two Oakland-based Strapt residents
music.summary: STRAPT brings Houston's IYKUK for her Bay Area debut alongside Oakland residents Discnogirl and DJ CARO for a night of Miami bass and East Coast club at Arcana.

music.name: Over Easy: Mars Kasei, Nikes, Heavee, Lonald J. Bandz, Rivs
music.why: N/A Sound's stacked jungle/juke/footwork 5th-anniversary lineup, NOTAFLOF-priced
music.summary: N/A Sound celebrates 5 years with its Guest Check series' biggest lineup yet — jungle, juke, hardcore and footwork from Heavee, Nikes, Mars Kasei and more at 9Lives.

music.name: Program Audio: Innerspeak:R (Saturday day + night)
music.why: A day-into-night techno/club takeover with staggered entry across two Saturday sessions
music.summary: Program Audio's multi-session weekend continues Saturday with a 4–9pm day set (Dance Maniacs, Soulox, Lonald J. Bandz) and a 10pm–4am night set (QRTR, PSL, Moonpie and more) at F8.

music.name: Antilands: Drive Unit, DJ Meg maig, Heat Exchange, moron.
music.why: Free lakeside day-into-night alternative to the Outside Lands crowds, BYOB and all ages
music.summary: Antilands is a free, all-day, all-ages house/disco/techno/jungle party at the Lake Merritt Bandstand, run as a lakeside counter-program to the festival across the bay.

music.name: Audiofreq + Code Black + Toneshifterz
music.why: Three touring hardstyle headliners on one bill at SF's longest-running dance club
music.summary: DNA Lounge hosts a hardstyle night headlined by touring acts Audiofreq, Code Black and Toneshifterz.

music.name: 2000s Rave
music.why: A nostalgia-themed 2000s pop/EDM throwback night at one of SF's biggest warehouse clubs
music.summary: The Midway's 2000s Rave spins early-2000s EDM, pop and dubstep/house/techno remixes for a nostalgia-themed night.

music.name: Bass Runch: Wub Zero, 5am Trio, Easy Jack, Manthom Phenace, Kaimera
music.why: A daytime dubstep/bass patio brunch session at The Midway
music.summary: Thematic Entertainment's Bass Runch is a daytime dubstep, bass and hip-hop patio session at The Midway featuring Wub Zero, 5am Trio and Easy Jack.

music.name: Fight Night: Live Wrestling Rave
music.why: Live wrestling matches staged inside a hard-dance/trap rave — a genuinely unusual crossover format
music.summary: Fight Night combines live wrestling matches with a hard dance, trap and hard techno rave at The Midway.

music.name: Borgore
music.why: A marquee touring dubstep/bass headliner at one of SF's largest club rooms
music.summary: Touring dubstep and drum-and-bass headliner Borgore plays The Midway.

music.name: Get Milked
music.why: House/disco night at one of SF's premier multi-room club venues
music.summary: Get Milked brings house and disco to Public Works' multi-room Mission District venue.

music.name: Crusy, Sebastian Fox, Trovato
music.why: Touring tech-house DJ Crusy at SoMa's dedicated multi-sensory club Halcyon
music.summary: Tech-house DJ Crusy headlines with Sebastian Fox and Trovato at Halcyon.

music.name: CASA Rave ft. Phendrana, Joey Trip, Blake Sol, Rey_Luv
music.venue: The California Theatre of Santa Rosa
music.why: A North Bay soulful-house/tech-house rave in a historic theatre room
music.summary: CASA Rave brings soulful house and tech house to the historic California Theatre of Santa Rosa, headlined by Phendrana.

music.name: Dil Se Rave: Terrace Edition — A South Asian EDM Rave
music.why: A South Asian-focused EDM/bollywood terrace rave, a niche not otherwise on this Saturday's bill
music.summary: Dil Se Rave: Terrace Edition is a South Asian EDM rave blending house, UK garage and bollywood on 620 Jones' rooftop terrace.

music.name: Cherry, Vic Vankman, Digital Kit Kat, Guerrilla Pump
music.why: A $5 door dive-bar night of freestyle, Miami bass and baile funk — the cheapest ticket on the bill
music.summary: The Knockout hosts a $5 night of freestyle, hi-NRG, Miami bass and baile funk with Cherry, Vic Vankman and Digital Kit Kat.

music.name: Denham Audio, Bianca Oblivion, DJ Manny presented by FATCAP & Public Works
music.why: Rare FATCAP crew booking pairs UK-rave-rooted bass with Chicago footwork in the main room.
music.summary: Denham Audio, Bianca Oblivion and DJ Manny headline a FATCAP & Public Works night blending UK hardcore-rooted rave sound with jungle, drum and bass, footwork and hip-hop.

music.name: program audio: innerspeak:r (Friday)
music.why: A 6-hour deep local-talent techno night that's the opening leg of a full two-day program audio weekend.
music.summary: Program audio's Friday night at F8 runs a stacked local lineup -- djfix, Chloe Battelle, sfcowboy, Oso Feo b2b M66, Taraneh, Lethargy and Aepricity -- from 10pm to 4am, the first of three sets in the 'innerspeak:r' weekend.

music.name: JAMBACK
music.why: Touring Dutch house DJ Jamback's first-ever Audio SF set.
music.summary: Dutch DJ Jamback makes his Audio SF debut on a house-focused night, supported by opener Emilio.

music.name: Nightshift
music.why: Two-room split lets you dance between classic goth/industrial and darkwave/post-punk without leaving the building.
music.summary: Nightshift turns two rooms at Cat Club over to darkwave, post-punk, synth, goth, industrial and dark-80s DJs Melting Girl, Sage, Starr Noir and Owen, a weekly Friday series confirmed for Aug 14 by 19hz.

music.name: LYNY, Villager, Tej, Ratchaelbeats
music.why: Two-room trap bill -- LYNY headlines the main floor while a separate Klub Room lineup runs alongside it.
music.summary: DJ Dials, Brownies and Lemonade and 1015 Folsom present a trap night with LYNY, Villager, Tej and Ratchaelbeats in the main room, plus Falldren and Btchplz in the Klub Room.

music.name: Shan Nash, Roderic, Hoolia presented by LUT Project and Safra
music.why: An intimate LUT Project showcase in the upstairs loft room, smaller and more personal than the main floor below.
music.summary: LUT Project and Safra present an intimate showcase at Public Works Loft with LUT founder Shan Nash alongside Roderic and Hoolia.

music.name: Dennis Quin, Jordy, Kohbain
music.why: Cheapest tech-house door price of the night if you arrive before 11pm.
music.summary: Amsterdam producer Dennis Quin headlines a tech house night at Halcyon with support from Jordy and Kohbain.

music.name: PRXZM, Juliet Daniel, Tasha Malan
music.why: An early (7-10pm) synthpop/electro slot in Kilowatt's small Mission room, over well before the night's later sets even start.
music.summary: PRXZM headlines an early electro and synthpop night at Kilowatt with support from Juliet Daniel and Tasha Malan.

music.name: Iz & Diz (Chicago)
music.why: A straight house-only bill in Monarch's two-level SoMa room, lighter and cheaper than the night's bigger techno tickets.
music.summary: Chicago house duo Iz & Diz play Monarch's two-level SoMa room, upstairs lounge and downstairs club floor.

music.name: Monstercat 15 Year feat. What So Not
music.why: A touring headliner (What So Not) and a label-anniversary production make this the biggest pure-EDM show of the night, spanning the Midway's indoor and outdoor Terrace stages.
music.summary: Monstercat celebrates its 15th anniversary with headliner What So Not across The Midway's indoor Gods & Monsters room and outdoor Terrace stage.

music.name: LOVE SUPREME: Summer Day Party Series (Travie Bobbito, King Most, Bella D. & Friends)
music.why: Backyard-party energy under the sun with a global afrobeats/amapiano/reggaeton crate, not a club-night sound
music.summary: LOVE SUPREME's Summer Day Party Series brings Travie Bobbito, King Most and Bella D. & Friends to The Chapel's outdoor stage for a 21+ daytime set spanning afrobeats, amapiano, baile funk, dancehall, house, latin house, r&b, rap and reggaeton.

music.name: Afro Thursdays: Mode Leeloo, HIDRA, Camillionaire, Irona
music.why: Free before 11pm gets you a weeknight afro-house set from a deep local lineup
music.summary: Teego SF's weekly Afro Thursdays residency brings Mode Leeloo, HIDRA, Camillionaire and Irona to F8's dancefloor for an afro-house and afro-tech night, 21+.

music.name: FLINTA Open Decks
music.why: A free weeknight open-decks floor built around FLINTA DJs, not a headliner bill
music.summary: A free Thursday open-decks night at Monarch curated for FLINTA (women, trans, and non-binary) DJs to play sets in a low-pressure club setting.

music.name: DJ Playstation
music.why: Free hi-fi listening-bar house set on a night with almost nothing else free
music.summary: DJ Playstation plays a free house set at Phonobar, the Hayes Valley audiophile cocktail lounge known for its high-end sound system, 21+.

music.name: Throwback Thursdays w/ DJ Mark Andrus
music.why: No-cover video-DJ dance party for a weeknight with drink specials, not a ticket
music.summary: DJ Mark Andrus spins 90s-to-present hip-hop, R&B and pop video sets at Raven Bar's weekly no-cover Thursday throwback party.

music.name: Valencia Live Night Market
music.address: Valencia St between 17th St and 20th St, San Francisco, CA 94110
music.why: Free open-air Mission street party with live music and dancing, no ticket needed
music.summary: Valencia Street closes to cars for this free monthly night market with live music, dancing, art-making and local vendors along the Mission's Valencia corridor.

sports.name: Silent Disco Night at the Church of 8 Wheels
sports.why: Three DJs battle live through color-coded silent-disco channels you switch on the fly
sports.summary: Weekly Tuesday roller-skate night inside a converted church where three DJs perform simultaneously through wireless silent-disco headphones, letting skaters vote which channel to follow and who returns next week.

sports.name: Golden Gate Running Club — Wednesday Track Workout
sports.why: Structured, no-drop track intervals for every pace, not just a social jog
sports.summary: Golden Gate Running Club hosts a weekly Wednesday track workout at Kezar Stadium, meeting on the south side of the track for rotating, coached speed sessions.

sports.name: Sunset Dunes parkrun
sports.address: 1349 Upper Great Highway, San Francisco, CA 94122
sports.why: A free, timed, weekly 5K along the ocean-view Great Highway promenade — no signup fee, all paces
sports.summary: Sunset Dunes parkrun is a free, weekly, volunteer-run timed 5K walk/jog/run along the Great Highway promenade next to Ocean Beach.

sports.name: Run for PB&J 5K/10K/13.1 San Francisco
sports.why: A low-key, playfully themed timed race with three distance options and a finisher medal
sports.summary: Run for PB&J is a peanut-butter-and-jelly-themed timed 5K/10K/half marathon at Fort Mason, run at your own pace with a swag bag and finisher's medal.

sports.name: Marin Roller "Disco Daze": Zombie Night
sports.address: 20 Avenue of the Flags, San Rafael, CA 94903
sports.why: A free, all-day outdoor roller disco with rentals available — this week's theme is zombies
sports.summary: Marin Roller "Disco Daze" is a free outdoor summer roller disco on Lagoon Island at the Marin Center Fairgrounds, with $5 skate rentals; this session is zombie-themed.

sports.name: SF Bicycle Coalition Women+ Ride
sports.why: A women+/nonbinary-focused group ride, the only cycling meetup on the calendar this Friday.
sports.summary: The San Francisco Bicycle Coalition hosts a women and nonbinary group ride departing McLaren Lodge at 7:30am, part of its 2nd-and-4th-Friday series.

sports.name: Midnight Rollers Friday Night Skate
sports.why: A free 12-mile weekly night skate through the city, the only skate event on tonight's calendar.
sports.summary: Midnight Rollers' San Francisco Friday Night Skate gathers under the Ferry Building clock tower for a roughly 12-mile group skate through the city, weekly, weather permitting.

sports.name: The SF Mile
sports.address: Old Mason St, Presidio, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: A rare USATF-certified flat road-mile format with elite heats, not a distance race
sports.summary: The SF Mile is an inaugural USATF-certified point-to-point road mile on Old Mason Street in the Presidio, run in multiple heats by ability from elite men/women down to a family walk-jog and a dog mile.

sports.name: Lands' End 5K
sports.address: Seal Rock Dr & El Camino del Mar, San Francisco, CA 94121
sports.why: An out-and-back trail 5K along the Lands End coastal cliffs, not a road loop
sports.summary: The Lands' End 5K starts at the USSSF Monument and runs north from Point Lobos Avenue along the Lands End Trail to Lincoln Highway and back, with Golden Gate and Pacific Ocean views; check-in at 8am, race at 9am.

sports.name: Trail Thursday: Ninja Lite Loop
sports.address: Conzelman Rd, Marin Headlands, Sausalito, CA 94965
sports.why: A 20-year-running pre-work trail tradition, not a road 5K — 1,500ft of climbing before 8am
sports.summary: San Francisco Running Company's weekly no-drop Trail Thursday group covers the 8.5-mile, ~1,500ft Ninja Lite loop through the Marin Headlands, meeting at 6am on the Golden Gate Bridge's north side.
